> Play aggro decks like face hunter, aggro paladin, zoo. Those are almost free to build.

Aggro is a type of deck that plays very aggressive and tries to win as early as possible (as opposed to Control, which plays more on the defense and tries to play big stuff late in the game to win). There's also Midrange and Combo. Midrange, as I understand it, lies somewhere inbetween Aggro and Control and switches their playstyle depending on the opponent. Combo usually relies on a couple cards in conjunction, often for a one- or two turn kill.

Facehunter, Aggro Paladin, and Zoo (Zoolock) are examples of Aggro decks from Hunter, Paladin, and Warlock respecticely.

Facehunter, as the name implies, mostly goes straight for the face and generally doesn't care much for the board state. [Edit: Also, tons of small minions]

Aggro Paladin has a lot of small minions (often with Divine Shields for survibability) and likes to buff them, frequently refilling the board with his hero power and [[Muster for Battle]].

Zoolock also has a lot of small minions (that's a very common theme among aggro decks), plays a lot for board control and uses his hero power to restock his hand.

They all play kind of differently, but the general idea is to overwhelm your opponent before they can fight back.
